name: Physics-Informed Operator Surrogate Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for scientific regression tasks that combine physical state assembly, spectral/operator neural surrogates, physics constraints, and metric-specific post-processing.
dejargonized_summary: Build physical state features, train a neural surrogate such as a transformer, Fourier Neural Operator, graph network, or spectral regressor, enforce physical constraints, and calibrate continuous predictions.

inputs.name: physical_observations
inputs.constraints: Gridded, spectral, sequence, graph, or tabular physical measurements.

outputs.name: physical_predictions
outputs.constraints: Continuous scientific predictions formatted for the metric.

use_when: The target is a physical quantity governed by conservation, smoothness, spectral, graph, or operator structure.
Winning solutions require FNO, transformer surrogates, PINN/PIGNN, spectral regression, or physics-informed constraints.
do_not_use_when: The task is ordinary image or tabular prediction with no physical state or scientific constraint.
A lightweight feature-engineering expansion of an existing tabular, image, or signal CDG captures the solution without an operator or physics-constrained surrogate.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is physical state construction followed by an operator or physics-constrained surrogate, not a generic estimator.

swappable_stages.operator_surrogate: Can be FNO, transformer, graph neural network, PINN, PIGNN, or a spectral regressor.

applicability.scaling_notes: Use chunked/HDF5 loading for large arrays and validate constraints on held-out physical regimes.
failure_modes: A surrogate can fit leaderboard metrics while violating physical invariants.
Incorrect coordinate or unit normalization breaks transfer across regimes.

planning_constraints.subject: physical_state_before_surrogate
planning_constraints.statement: Assemble coordinates, units, state tensors, and physical context before applying an operator or physics-informed surrogate.
planning_constraints.rationale: The surrogate stage learns over physical state structure rather than raw unaligned observations.

planning_constraints.subject: constraint_projection_after_prediction
planning_constraints.statement: Apply conservation, boundary, positivity, smoothness, or metric-specific physical constraints after raw surrogate prediction.
planning_constraints.rationale: Constraint projection depends on predicted physical quantities and cannot be performed before the surrogate produces them.

audit.rationale: Added after expansion validation left repeated unmatched scientific modeling solutions requiring physical state assembly, operator learning, and explicit constraints.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This covers scientific tasks where a model learns a physical input-output relationship and then enforces domain constraints.
uncertainty_notes: Specific operator families such as FNO, PINN, PIGNN, and spectral regressors may later become refinements or atoms.

references.title: Sciona expansion support-3 validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched solution patterns.

stages.name: Physical State Assembly
stages.description: Load gridded, sequence, graph, spectral, or tabular physical observations and construct state tensors with coordinates, units, and exogenous variables.
stages.dejargonized_description: Prepare physical inputs with coordinates, units, and derived state variables.
preconditions: Coordinate system and units are known.
guarantees: State tensors have consistent axes and units.

stages.name: Spectral or Graph Features
stages.description: Compute vertical differences, Fourier features, graph neighborhoods, chemistry descriptors, or spectral basis features.
stages.dejargonized_description: Create scientific features that expose known physical structure.
preconditions: Feature transforms match the coordinate system.

stages.name: Operator Surrogate
stages.description: Train an FNO, transformer, graph neural network, PINN/PIGNN, or spectral regression model to map state features to targets.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train a model that learns the physical input-output operator.
guarantees: Predictions have the required target shape.

stages.name: Constraint Projection
stages.description: Apply conservation, smoothness, positivity, boundary, or biogeochemical constraints to raw predictions.
stages.dejargonized_description: Correct predictions so they satisfy required physical constraints.
guarantees: Predictions satisfy explicit constraints or expose violations.

stages.name: Metric Postprocessing
stages.description: Apply weighted least squares, detrending, smoothing, uncertainty aggregation, or target-specific clipping before submission.
stages.dejargonized_description: Calibrate continuous predictions for the benchmark metric.
preconditions: Metric and output format are known.
